title: Banners: off in the Console, always on in Patches; _ minimize buttons; all banners launch expanded
asked: Disable all banner plugins from console and enable them in patches so they are always there regardless what app you are in. Put a _ underneath the x on codebase changes to minimize banner. Replace the x with an _ for the 2 building banners and any error banners. All banners launch expanded

steps.text: Console: banner strip page (?axf-strip=banners), banners off in the console by default, action relay to the Console tab
Patches: banner strip web view above the app, sized to its banners, opens the Console tab for banner actions
Activity + systems-check/keys banners: _ minimizes instead of x; every banner launches expanded
Codebase changes _ under the x + Build manager _ (after the running Build manager build finishes)

result.summary: Plugin banners off on the console page, shown in Patches above every tab via the console's banner strip (?axf-strip=banners); taps open in the Console tab. _ minimizes activity, build manager, systems check and keys banners; codebase changes has _ under its ✕ column; every banner launches expanded. PR #7 (on #5) and PR #8 (on #6), CI green, patches-debug.apk built.
